test_eigen_fixed_matrices: test pybind11 Eigen fixed-size matrix bindings with numpy arrays for row and column major layouts
test_eigen_dense_matrices: test pybind11 Eigen dynamic-size matrix bindings with numpy arrays for row and column major layouts
test_eigen_mutator_descriptors: test pybind11 Eigen mutator functions that modify numpy arrays in place with shape and contiguity checks
test_eigen_cpp_casting: test pybind11 Eigen C++ casting of numpy arrays to Eigen matrix types by value and reference
test_eigen_sparse_matrices: test pybind11 Eigen sparse matrix bindings with scipy sparse CSR and CSC matrix formats
